name: Torr2Jelly
description: Standalone TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features embedded zero-config TorrServer daemon, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Fix Jellyfin SPA rendering: embed complete CSS styling and JS controllers directly in HTML without external link/controller dependencies. Fixes unstyled layout and tab switching.
Rich Glassmorphism UI redesign matching torr2jelly web app, Gold/Freeleech filters, direct TorrServer stream URLs, and automated defaults.
Initial standalone release with embedded TorrServer daemon and Prowlarr integration.
